## Attest a record

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Attester
    participant AttestationRegistry
    participant AttesterRegistry
    Attester->>AttestationRegistry: attest [auth: Attester]
    AttestationRegistry->>AttesterRegistry: is_attester
    Note over AttestationRegistry: event AttestationRecorded
```

## Claim an incentive payout

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Attester
    participant IncentivePool
    participant AttestationRegistry
    Attester->>IncentivePool: claim [auth: Attester]
    IncentivePool->>AttestationRegistry: get_attestation
    Note over IncentivePool: event PayoutClaimed
```

## Enroll an attester with a licence credential

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Registrar
    participant AttesterRegistry
    Registrar->>AttesterRegistry: enroll_with_credential [auth: Registrar]
    AttesterRegistry->>AttesterRegistry: add_attester_with_info
    Note over AttesterRegistry: event AttesterAdded
```

## Revoke an attestation

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Attester
    participant AttestationRegistry
    Attester->>AttestationRegistry: revoke_attestation [auth: Attester]
    Note over AttestationRegistry: event AttestationRevoked
```

sequenceDiagram
